title: Vietnamese Vegan Pilchard-Free Kho
description: A vegan twist on the traditional Vietnamese kho dish, replacing pilchards with plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Marinate the sliced onions in rice vinegar for at least 30 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add the marinated onions to the pan and sauté until they start to caramelize.
Add the cubed chayote squash to the pan and continue to sauté for another 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegan stock and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes or until the squash is tender.
Stir in the kho sauce and soy sauce. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
